gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed Grade IV GBM/gliosarcoma (WHO criteria; non-IDH R132Hmutant by immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] or, sequencing for IDH1 and 2 in case of patients \>55 years) established following either a radical or partial surgical resection.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will evaluate the addition of regorafenib to standard of care treatment with TMZ as adjuvant therapy, and in combination with TMZ+RT as concomitant therapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Patients With Newly Diagnosed MGMT-Methylated, IDH Wild-type Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetics parameters - AUC: area under the plasma concentration versus time curve

role_evidence.quote: This study will evaluate the addition of regorafenib to standard of care treatment with TMZ as adjuvant therapy, and in combination with TMZ+RT as concomitant therapy.

The standard of care for newly diagnosed GBM (ndGBM) includes surgical resection to the extent that is safely feasible, followed by RT plus concomitant TMZ chemotherapy, and up to 6 months of adjuvant TMZ.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent (standard of care GBM backbone)

source_quote.quote: Methylated MGMT according to local laboratory (in case of pyrosequencing, methylation \>10%)
NOTE: Patients with known isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) 1 and 2 are to be excluded.

coder_notes: Newly diagnosed IDH-wildtype, MGMT-methylated GBM; regorafenib added to standard TMZ (adjuvant, cohort A) or TMZ+RT (concomitant, cohort B). Regorafenib only investigational agent -> experimental_monotherapy; TMZ soc_backbone; regimen combination (TMZ in both cohorts, RT in cohort B). Two sequential experimental dose-escalation cohorts, neither a control -> control_arm_from_other_arms no. MGMT methylation and IDH-wildtype are entry requirements, never candidate-matched. PK plasma only. Fluorescein/5-ALA mentioned only in exclusion notes, not listed.
